text:
lia: Continuing the onboarding RFC follow-up: I want to propose a small "descriptor_provenance" addition to model descriptors so we can trace who suggested weights/defaults and how backfills were computed. Quick thread of tradeoffs.
lia: Motivation: we keep backfilling sample_weight from production traces; when a regression happens we need to know if the weight was user-provided, auto-suggested, or inferred.
omar: sketch?
lia: Example descriptor fragment I imagine: 
```json
{
  "model_id": "acme/luna:2026-03",
  "sample_weight": [ { "seqlen": 8, "pct": 0.6 }, { "seqlen": 256, "pct": 0.4 } ],
  "descriptor_provenance": { "source": "auto-suggest", "hinted_by": "ingest-telemetry-2026-02", "computed_at": "2026-03-10T14:12:00Z" }
}
```
lia: Reasonable?
sara: I like it, but small rule: provenance must be non-PII and limited to short tags (no raw trace IDs).
omar: Also think about size: we don't want large history embedded in every descriptor. Maybe a single-line provenance plus an optional `provenance_url` pointing to a catalog entry?
ravi: If we allow `provenance_url` we need access controls so private orgs' metadata doesn't leak. Intake should redact or sign the URL.
lia: Good catch. We'll require `provenance_url` to be ACL'd and only visible to org members. Otherwise fall back to short tags.
bench-bot: automated: suggestion: when sample_weight is missing, bench should run a 5-minute quick-scan to produce a suggested weight and post a draft descriptor to /catalog/drafts/<model>.
both: ooh
ravi: Operational tradeoff: quick-scan increases ingress cost but avoids human guesswork. We should budget this as `auto_suggest_budget` and cap per org.
sara: UX: auto-suggest draft should be Reviewable in the console and include a one-click accept that promotes to canonical descriptor. Without acceptance after 30 days auto-suggest remains draft and bench keeps using cluster defaults.
omar: Compatibility note: some runtimes will behave differently for mid-range seqlens; specify `seqlen_buckets` with an optional `preferred_bucket` to bias warmup. Example: `seqlen_buckets: [{"min":1,"max":32},{"min":33,"max":256}]`.
lia: We should also include a small `quick_smoke_cmd` snippet that intake can show vendors: e.g., `redwood-smoke --model acme/luna:2026-03 --runs 10 --seqlen 8,256`. Helps debugging.
sara: Another interface boundary: who should own auto-suggested backfill runs? Option A: bench triggers and writes draft descriptors. Option B: ingest triggers and writes drafts. I lean bench triggers because it already does sampling.
ravi: Bench team here: we prefer bench owns it but intake must validate and stamp before promotion. That keeps bench logic local but intake has final authority.
lia: Security: ensure drafts have `signed_by` and `signature_ts` so we can verify who created them. `admit-bot` should reject unsigned drafts for promotion.
admit-bot: [automated] rule added: `draft_descriptor` must include `signed_by` when `source==auto-suggest`.
bench-bot: question: how to handle tokenizers that evolve? If tokenizer_fingerprint changes for a model id we'd want to trigger a re-sample.
sara: policy: any tokenizer_fingerprint drift triggers a mandatory re-bench and invalidates previous sample_weight unless `descriptor_provenance.source==explicit-owner`. So owner-provided weights are trusted, otherwise recompute.
omar: Edgecase: vendor uploads quantized binaries with unknown `quant_abi_version`. We should block them and return a clear error: `quant_abi_version required for quantized artifacts`.
lia: Agreed. Also add `compatibility_tags` array to help operators map to runtime feature toggles: e.g., `["kv-short-kv-opt", "attn-fuse-v3"]`. Keep tags short.
ravi: Rollout plan proposal: week 0: add provenance fields as optional + console UI for drafts. Week 3: enable auto-suggest quick-scan opt-in for high-traffic orgs. Week 7: require provenance for new models and promote signed drafts for existing models incrementally.
sara: Follow-ups: I can draft schema + console UX mockups. Omar will coordinate ACLs. Ravi + bench team will scope autosuggest cost. Lia will write promotion/signing contract.
lia: tiny note: make sure all new fields are backward compatible; default semantics should map to cluster defaults so older descriptors still pass.
admit-bot: [automated] created issue: /infra/ingest#891 - add descriptor_provenance to admit contract.
sara: thanks, will subscribe. :thumbsup:
